name: vintage-classic-car-maintenance-restoration-records
productName: Vintage & Classic Vehicle Maintenance & Restoration Records – Collector Edition
description: Worldwide Collector Edition with separate vehicle workspaces, vehicle status categories, GitHub bug reporting, automatic updates, USB portable mode, themes, dashboards and professional reports.
author: Personal Use

scripts.check: node --check app/main/main.js && node --check app/preload/preload.js && node tests/project-smoke-test.js
scripts.build:installer: npm run build:portable-runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.installer.json --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:portable: npm run check && electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.json --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:both: npm run build:installer && npm run build:portable
scripts.build:portable-runtime: npm run check && electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.json --x64 --publish never && npm run stage:portable-runtime
scripts.build:msi: npm run check && electron-builder --config electron-builder.msi.json --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:all: npm run build:installer && npm run build:portable && npm run build:msi

build.productName: Vintage & Classic Vehicle Maintenance & Restoration Records – Collector Edition

nsis.shortcutName: Vintage & Classic Vehicle Maintenance & Restoration Records – Collector Edition
nsis.uninstallDisplayName: Vintage & Classic Vehicle Maintenance & Restoration Records – Collector Edition
